method: Short period: FY2023 is MBC Group's first statutory period, 20 April 2023 (incorporation) to 31 December 2023, with the Group entities consolidated prospectively from 30 June 2023 (about six months of operations). There are no FY2022 statutory statements, so growth is n.m.
notes: short period. Note 30(b) of the FY2023 AFS (p.71) gives pro-forma figures as if the Group had always existed (2022 revenue SAR 3,488.7m; 2023 SAR 3,703.9m); they are additional information, not statutory, and are not used.

method: Short period: FY2024 (12 months) is compared with the FY2023 statutory period (20 April-31 December 2023, subsidiaries consolidated from 30 June 2023). Reported growth (FY2024 SAR 4,196m vs FY2023 SAR 1,712m) is n.m.
notes: short period. For context only: FY2024 revenue is 13.3% above the pro-forma 12-month 2023 revenue of SAR 3,703.9m in note 30(b) (FY2023 AFS p.71, we calculate); the pro forma is not statutory and is not used in the tables.

method: No business combination or disposal of a subsidiary in FY2025 (no IFRS 3 note; subsidiary list unchanged). ACSC moved from associate to an FVTPL investment on 15 May 2025 and the MBC Game Studio joint venture is equity-accounted; neither is in revenue.
notes: Organic growth before FX = reported growth (+28.5%).

method: Revenue from contracts earned in Egypt was SAR 416.3m in FY2025 (SAR 267.8m in FY2024) and the Egyptian pound weakened against the riyal; the filings give no constant-currency figures. GCC revenue (UAE dirham, riyal) is pegged to the USD.
notes: Egypt is 9.8% of revenue from contracts in FY2025 (we calculate).

method: Revenue is presented on the same basis in both years: revenue from contracts with customers plus other operating revenues (KSA government funding treated as government grants, note 5). The FY2025 AFS reclassified SAR 1.8m between direct costs and G&A for FY2024 (note 30), with no revenue effect.
notes: Other operating revenues rose from SAR 659.4m to SAR 1,146.8m (production initiatives SAR 308.1m to SAR 774.9m); this is part of reported and organic growth.

method: MBC discloses no capacity or unit measures (channels launched, Shahid subscribers, hours of content), so revenue from new capacity cannot be separated.
notes: Like-for-like growth not determinable; organic growth before FX is the closest measure.

method: The interim statements give no geographic revenue split or constant-currency figures; Egyptian operations (MEP Egypt, MMS Egypt) remain consolidated.
